name: Mobileye
resolved_from: company name 'Mobileye' - web_search returned both careers.mobileye.com/jobs (branded landing) and jobs.eu.lever.co/mobileye (Lever board) as separate results; picked the Lever one per Step 0.1. Recorded in the project instructions, not re-verified live in this session.

israel_filter._note: Lever's own UI is a flat_multi_location picker (verified in the skill's investigation_playbook.md), but this profile is fetch_type=api, so the picker is never touched. The API returns every posting's location in one call.

detail_fetch._note: VERIFIED live on 2026-08-12. method=inline, NOT html: the same listing call that returns the postings already carries the full description, so per-posting page fetches would buy nothing and cost one request each (cheap-to-expensive rule). inline_field=lists specifically - this was tested field by field against the real parser across 25 Israel-relevant postings: `description` and `descriptionBody` hold only the intro paragraph and produced a number on 0 of 25, while `lists` produced one on 18 of 25 (+3 with seniority signals, 4 with nothing). `lists` is a structured array ([{text: heading, content: '<li>..'}]), not a string, which is why detail.render_sections exists. The section headings it carries are the recruiter-invented ones this design was built around - 'All you need is:' / 'Nice to have:' - and the heading promotion in experience.classify_block is what makes the unmarked bullets under them count. The Lever posting PAGE does also serve the description in static HTML (so method=html would work), but it is strictly more expensive for identical data.

health._note: VERIFIED live on 2026-08-11: api.eu.lever.co/v0/postings/mobileye returned 122 Israel-relevant postings. expected_min_jobs=20 is a conservative floor well below the observed count, to tolerate normal fluctuation without disabling the health gate; zero_is_plausible=false since a large company like Mobileye genuinely going to 0 open roles would itself be worth a maintenance alert, not silent state loss.

notes: Endpoint and field names come from api_platforms.md, which itself documents this as verified during the original project investigation (not this session). The .eu subdomain matters - api.lever.co (non-EU) 404s for this slug. Live-verified via a direct API call on 2026-08-11 (122 Israel-relevant jobs returned) before this profile was put into production, and re-verified on 2026-08-12 when detail_fetch was added (141 postings, 122 Israel-relevant - unchanged).
